note: The closest thing to an ICP fit in this batch. Senior corporate figure with regional responsibility for the Middle East, relocated internationally to take over a retiring colleague's role, eleven years in Dubai — successful and funded, with no resistance to the price beyond 'I'll have to double check the finances.' Health is unambiguously the neglected area of an otherwise functioning life, and he is nowhere near the excluded profile: thirty years a cyclist, walks 50km a month, already owns kettlebells, and is anything but gym-averse. He misses on starting point, and materially. The stated ICP excludes rescue, and at 57 he is 10kg above his lifetime maximum, in joint pain, sleeping badly, energy collapsed, unable to crouch comfortably — 'I'd love to get back to where I was' is restoration, not good to great.
